name: Lighthouse Mara
description: Investigate why Lighthouse Mara went dark and restore its power. The first real expedition into the Nightside — something beneath the lighthouse has broken through.

descend_caverns.label: Descend into the Frozen Caverns
descend_caverns.description: A passage beneath the relay station leads deeper. Explore the frozen caverns below Lighthouse Mara.

find_keeper.label: Find the Lighthouse Keeper
find_keeper.description: Someone may have survived the collapse. Search the caverns for survivors.

reach_core.label: Reach the Lighthouse Core
reach_core.description: Descend to the lighthouse's power core. The keeper says a backup power cell can restart the systems.

restore_power.label: Restore Lighthouse Power
restore_power.description: Route power through both conduits, clear the core chamber, and restart the lighthouse.

lines: The lighthouse beam cuts across the Nightside once more. But the fractures in the deep rock tell a story that goes far beyond a failed relay station.
Something ancient is stirring beneath the surface. The seismic survey data might interest someone at the Deep Array — if you can find it.
